s.en: The nurse is kind to every patient.
The doctor was kind to my mother yesterday.
s.ko: 의사 선생님은 어제 제 어머니께 친절하셨어요.

s.en: I will be kind to my neighbors.
My friend is honest and kind.
The child was honest about the broken plate this morning.
s.ko: 그 아이는 오늘 아침 깨진 접시에 대해 솔직했어요.

s.en: I will be honest with the doctor.
s.ko: 저는 의사 선생님께 솔직하게 말할 거예요.

s.en: The child is brave at the clinic.
She was brave during the treatment yesterday.
You will be brave tomorrow.
My mother is patient with the children.
The teacher was patient with me last year.
s.ko: 작년에 선생님은 저에게 참을성 있게 대해 주셨어요.

s.en: I will be patient and walk slowly.
s.ko: 저는 참을성 있게 천천히 걸을 거예요.

s.en: The young man is polite to old people.
The nurse was polite on the phone yesterday.
s.ko: 어제 간호사는 전화로 예의 바르게 응대했어요.

s.en: I will be polite to the new neighbor.
s.ko: 저는 새 이웃에게 예의 바르게 대할 거예요.

s.en: My neighbor is friendly and warm.
The doctor was friendly this morning.
The new nurse will be friendly.
I am careful with hot water.
She was careful on the wet road yesterday.
I will be careful with the medicine.
My cat is very clever.
The child gave a clever answer yesterday.
s.ko: 그 아이는 어제 영리한 대답을 했어요.

s.en: You will find a clever answer.
The child is shy with new people.
s.ko: 그 아이는 낯선 사람 앞에서 수줍어해요.

s.en: I was shy in the class yesterday.
She will not be shy after a few days.
s.ko: 며칠 지나면 그녀는 수줍어하지 않을 거예요.

s.en: The doctor is serious about my heart problem.
s.ko: 의사 선생님은 제 심장 문제를 진지하게 보세요.

s.en: The cough was serious last winter.
The cough will not be serious.
